stem:
Ritu wants the wet clothes on her balcony to dry faster. She tries four different arrangements on four different days.

1 spreading the clothes out in direct sunlight
2 hanging the clothes folded in a shady corner indoors
3 spreading the clothes out on a windy balcony
4 leaving the clothes in a closed, humid bathroom

Which two arrangements make the water evaporate faster?

teacher.key_rationale: Evaporation is faster with warmth/sunlight (1) and with moving air and large exposed area (3). Shade indoors (2) and a closed humid bathroom (4) slow evaporation. Hence the correct pair is 1 and 3, option B. Option A traps students who count sunlight only; C and D pair slow conditions with fast ones.
